faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our claims process

q1.question: What types of baggage damage are covered?
q1.answer: We cover all types of physical damage to checked baggage that occurred during your Eurowings flight, including broken wheels, torn fabric, damaged handles, dents, and scratches. Cosmetic wear and tear from normal use is not covered.

q2.question: What information do I need to file a claim?
q2.answer: You'll need your booking reference or flight number, photos of the damage, and a brief description of what happened. Our AI assistant will guide you through exactly what's needed.

q3.question: How long does the process take?
q3.answer: Most claims are processed within 24 hours. You'll receive a notification once a decision has been made. If additional information is needed, our AI assistant will reach out to you promptly.

q4.question: How will I receive my compensation?
q4.answer: Compensation is typically processed via bank transfer or as a voucher for future Eurowings flights, depending on the nature and extent of the damage.

q5.question: Can I check the status of my claim?
q5.answer: Yes! You can check your claim status at any time by returning to the chat interface. You'll also receive email notifications at key stages of the process.

q6.question: What if I need to provide additional information?
q6.answer: If our system needs more details, you'll receive a notification via email with a link to continue the conversation with our AI assistant. Simply click the link and provide the requested information.
